brand.name: Forgewright
brand.tagline: Self-hosted CI/CD for developers who build things

sections.purpose: App shell with sidebar and top bar
sections.copy: Sidebar: 'Forgewright' wordmark with a small line-icon nav (active: 'Pipelines'). Top bar: 'Pipeline Dashboard' title, search field, and avatar/menu.

sections.purpose: Toolbar row with page heading and controls
sections.copy: Page heading: 'Pipeline Dashboard'. Controls: segmented control for date range (Today, This Week, All Time), primary button 'Refresh Data'.
3 metric cards: 'Build Success Rate' (92.4%, -1.2% delta in red), 'Average Build Duration' (3.2 min, +0.5 min delta in amber), 'Total Pipeline Runs' (1,245, +125 delta in green).

A hand-built inline SVG line chart showing pipeline success rate over the last 30 days. X-axis: dates, Y-axis: success rate. Emphasized endpoint: 92.4% on the last day. Gridlines in #232a2d, axis labels in monospace, semantic color for delta.

A realistic table with header row: 'Build ID', 'Status', 'Duration', 'Branch', 'Started At'. 5 rows of data: 'BR-2024-04-05-12', 'Success', '3.2 min', 'main', '2024-04-05 12:00'; status pills: 'Success' (green), 'Failed' (red), 'Pending' (amber). Hover row state: subtle inner glow.

An activity feed with items: 'Pipeline BR-2024-04-05-12 completed successfully', 'Branch main merged into dev', 'Build BR-2024-04-05-11 failed at step 3'. Each item includes a small icon, timestamp, and a faint grid texture.

palette_hint: Near-black tinted ground #0b0e0f, surface #14181a, light ink #e6edf0, muted #8a97a0, glowing accent #00e08a
type_hint: Monospace for code/labels/numerals, system sans for prose; small uppercase tracked labels
